title: adenostemma lavenia var. elatum
intro: Adenostemma lavenia var. elatum, commonly known as "Makalika" or "Blue Porterweed", is a plant species within the Acanthaceae family. It is traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Adenostemma lavenia var. elatum include its ability to reduce fever, relieve cough, and alleviate digestive discomfort, making it a valuable plant in traditional Hawaiian medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
